title: GeoPro Labs Inc: Head of Operations - Shopify App Portfolio
text:
Headquarters: Victoria, British Columbia, Canada
URL: https://geoproapp.com
The opportunity
I'm looking for an experienced operator to take ownership of a portfolio of three established Shopify apps with a combined ARR of approximately $1.87M.
The portfolio includes:
Geo:Pro: Geolocation-based storefront personalization
TrackiPal: PayPal tracking automation for Shopify merchants
Easy Lockdown: Content and storefront access control
Together, these are profitable, well-established products with engaged customer bases. They're not hypergrowth startups, but well-run businesses with clear opportunities to improve the product experience, strengthen operations and continue growing over time.
As the portfolio has grown, it's reached the point where I need an experienced operator to lead the day-to-day, keep the business running smoothly and turn strategy into execution.
The role is fully remote, async-friendly and suited to someone who enjoys ownership, autonomy and building well-run businesses.
What you'd own
Team coordination and delivery: Run the day-to-day by coordinating the developer and tester through the full delivery cycle - from spec → build → ship → measure - keeping everyone aligned across time zones and hiring additional contractors as needed.
Roadmap and prioritization: We'll set the roadmap together. I'll be closely involved at first, and over time this becomes increasingly your call. Turn Amplitude data, review themes and support signals into a prioritized backlog in Linear, and write clear tickets for the developer.
Metrics and experimentation: Own the analytics story. Understand what moved, what didn't and what to try next. Design experiments and report on impact.
Quality and documentation: Continually raise the bar on user experience through better documentation, smoother onboarding, fewer rough edges.
Platform stewardship: Stay ahead of Shopify API changes, manage App Store compliance reviews and lead our annual Built for Shopify review to retain BFS status.
Support oversight and escalations: Our support agency handles tier-1 tickets. You're the escalation point for product and engineering issues and own the agency relationship, ensuring response times, ticket quality and the merchant experience meet the bar.
Shopify App Store Paid Ads: Oversee existing paid advertising campaigns, working with our marketing contractor to ensure everything runs smoothly. We'll set the marketing budget together each quarter, and you'll manage it.
Shopify App Store rankings: Monitor Shopify App Store rankings across the portfolio, identify opportunities to improve rankings and respond quickly when rankings decline.
What you don't have to do
Write code (there's a developer for that)
Do QA (there's a tester for that)
Handle routine support tickets (an agency handles that)
Respond to reviews (a contractor handles that)
Fundraise, hire executives, sit in stakeholder meetings or manage political overhead - none of that exists here
Growth areas we've already identified
Easy Lockdown: Shift to usage-based pricing
Geo:Pro + Easy Lockdown: Onboarding and activation optimization
Geo:Pro + Easy Lockdown: Feature gaps that address missing customer use cases
All three apps: Lift review ratings to improve organic App Store rankings
You're not walking into a blank page - there's already a clear direction, but plenty of room to test your own ideas.
What you'll be walking into
Small, remote team: You'll be coordinating a small team of contractors working across different time zones, so communication and keeping work moving are a big part of the role.
Established products: The apps are profitable and well established, but some of the codebases are older and occasionally require pragmatic workarounds rather than perfect solutions.
Data-driven decisions: Our analytics stack is solid (Amplitude, BigQuery, Shopify Partners) - SQL fluency, or comfort writing it with AI help, is required.
How we'll work together
Founder involvement: I've run these apps alongside another business and know them inside out. I'll stay focused on product direction, strategy, quarterly planning and major decisions while you run the day-to-day.
Working rhythm: We'll meet weekly at first while we build context and alignment, then move to monthly strategy check-ins and quarterly planning sessions. Beyond that, you'll have the autonomy to run with it.
Who you are
Strong operator: You've successfully run product or delivery for a small SaaS team. Background isn't important - results are.
Technically fluent: You can write clear product specs, understand trade-offs and weigh development estimates without needing to review code.
Organized and proactive: You enjoy coordinating people, removing blockers and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.
Data-driven: You use Amplitude, SQL and customer feedback to inform decisions.
Self-directed: You're comfortable working asynchronously, managing your own priorities and taking ownership without constant direction.
Bonus: Experience in the Shopify ecosystem, App Store Optimization (ASO), paid acquisition or SaaS growth.
Where this could go
This isn't a role with a fixed ceiling. As you build context, take on more responsibility and the portfolio grows, there's scope for the role to grow too. Exactly what that looks like will depend on the business and the impact you have, but the door is genuinely open.
Role details
Time: Part-time, approximately 15-25 hours per week
Compensation: US$65-$85/hour, depending on experience
Employment: Contractor or employee - whichever works best for you
Location: Fully remote, async-friendly, any timezone
Start: As soon as you're available
How to apply

title: Coaching.com: Membership Coordinator
text:
Headquarters: United States

Membership Coordinator
GENERAL INFORMATION
Department
Membership
Reporting to
Membership Manager & Director
Start Date
Immediate
Salary
US$28,000.00/annually
IS THIS YOU?
Do your friends and family consistently come to you for advice on organization?
When going on a road trip, are you the one with the directions, playlist, and backup plan ready in the passenger seat?
Do your friends make fun of you for your checklists, color-coded calendars, or goal-tracking obsession?
Is Mel Robins at the top of your podcast playlist?
Do micro-managers give you the ick?
Are you the friend who remembers birthdays, sends thoughtful follow-up messages, and keeps everyone in the loop?
Are you the person who reads the entire instruction manual before assembling something, then teaches everyone else how to do it?
Have people in your life been mildly annoyed with you because of your incessant follow-up and “just confirming” messages?
Have you ever caught an error in a shared document that everyone else missed?
Do you get a little bothered when files are saved in the wrong folder or named inconsistently?
Are you looking for a company that acknowledges your independence and rewards you accordingly?
ROLE PURPOSE
We are a global educational company, and our mission is to harness the power of coaching worldwide. We achieve this through our Coaching Enablement Platform, offering a comprehensive suite of services designed to support and accelerate coaches' development. Our services include the Coaching Center of Excellence (a hub for professional development and education), Coaching Management Software, and Coaching Marketplace. Through these platforms, we empower coaches to shape their skills and have a profound impact on human life.
As a Membership Coordinator, you will play a vital role in managing and coordinating various aspects of our membership programs and community engagement initiatives. This role is ideal for a proactive, confident and detail-oriented individual who is passionate about supporting professional development and fostering a sense of community among our members.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:
Within the first 90 days, the Membership Coordinator will:
Deliver recurring membership communications, reminders, session logistics, and follow-ups accurately and on schedule.
Maintain timely, transparent communication with members, facilitators, speakers, and Membership team.
Ensure all session links, registration/access settings, automations, and resources are tested before they are shared externally.
Maintain complete, accurate, and accessible program records, reports, and SOPs.
Proactively flag risks, blockers, unclear ownership, or missed deadlines before they affect members or facilitators.
Establish a clear, consistent operating rhythm so the Membership Manager and Director always have visibility into progress and confidence that work is complete and accurate.
RESPONSIBILITIES
The Membership Coordinator reports directly to the Membership Manager & Membership Director to support the delivery training and education to our Members.
Your main responsibility is to support, coordinate and execute membership delivery administrative tasks, ensuring agreed program milestones are met. The role also has a specific focus on managing volunteer facilitators, hosting and providing technical support on live sessions, and coordinating the monthly newsletter.
Membership Project Management:
Own the day-to-day coordination of assigned membership programs, projects, communications, and recurring administrative workflows.
Build, maintain, and update project plans, task lists, deadlines, owners, dependencies, and status updates in Asana.
Ensure every assigned task has a clear owner, deadline, intended outcome, and documented completion status.
Provide daily updates on weekly priorities, progress, risks, blockers, and next steps in the designated Membership team channel or project-management system.
Schedule meetings; prepare agendas, materials, and links; capture decisions and action items; and distribute follow-up notes promptly.
Maintain an accurate membership operations calendar covering sessions, facilitator commitments, speaker commitments, member communications, reminders, deadlines, and follow-up requirements.
Identify repetitive manual work and recommend or implement approved automations to improve accuracy, timeliness, and efficiency.
Membership Delivery:
Collaborate with the Membership Team on delivery, design & development processes.
Acknowledge all member, facilitator, speaker, and internal emails within 24–48 business hours, even when a full resolution requires more time.
Escalate sensitive member issues, complaints, refund/payment concerns, access problems, or unresolved requests to the Membership Manager promptly.
Coordinate the operational delivery of membership sessions, coaching circles, learning experiences, workshops, and summits.
Complete quality assurance before any member-facing launch or send, including testing registration links, access permissions, invite links, reminders, automations, quiz links, recordings, and resource downloads in a test account where applicable.
Coordinate and compile new member and cancellation data, ensuring timely and relevant information is shared across teams.
Support the delivery of live membership sessions on Zoom, including session support, session hosting, logistical coordination, scheduling and content preparation.
Upload, title, tag, and publish recordings and resources in the Membership Resource and Recording Library in Circle according to established standards.
Update SOPs promptly whenever a workflow, platform, automation, communication sequence, or ownership model changes.
Assist with general administrative tasks related to membership management, including summit coordination, member database maintenance, and documentation.
Hosting coverage when needed.
Facilitator Coordination:
Manage and coordinate volunteer facilitators, allocating sessions, being their point of contact and ensuring they are well-prepared for the sessions they are facilitating.
Maintain complete facilitator records, including session assignment, attendance, feedback, completed reports, outstanding actions, and follow-up needs.
Collect, review, and file session and facilitator reports for completeness, accuracy, and required follow-up before closing them.
Speaker Coordination:
Support the Membership Director with speaker research, outreach, booking, scheduling, confirmation, preparation, and post-event follow-up.
Send and track speaker invitations, calendar holds, confirmation emails, reminder emails, asset requests, biographies, headshots, slides, workbooks, and handouts.
Ensure speaker materials meet our standards before publication and are stored in the correct central location.
Coordinate collection of testimonials, speaker thank-yous, post-session feedback, and all required follow-up communications.
KEY COMPETENCIES
Ownership and follow-through
You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. You close loops, verify delivery, track follow-up, and do not consider work complete until the intended result has been achieved.
You’re proactive
You keep the team informed without being asked. You surface risks early, seek clarification, communicate delays immediately, and propose a recovery plan when a problem arises.
Detail and quality orientation
You are meticulous with links, access, dates, time zones, lists, group assignments, reports, and member communications. You use checklists and testing to prevent avoidable errors.
Member and stakeholder care
You communicate with warmth, professionalism, and urgency. You understand that incomplete follow-up, missed reminders, or unclear information can damage a member’s or facilitator’s experience.
Adaptability
You can handle shifting priorities while protecting critical recurring work. You know how to distinguish urgent tasks from important tasks and ask for direction when priorities conflict.
Confidence in live settings
You are comfortable hosting and supporting online sessions, communicating calmly in front of groups, solving basic technical issues, and representing us professionally.
BENEFITS
Flexible working hours, with at least 50% overlap with Eastern Time / New York business hours.
Fully remote work environment.
Access to our events, training, and expert-led learning experiences.
Annual professional-development plan and training budget.
Unlimited Time Off, subject to advance coordination and continued coverage of critical member-facing responsibilities.
Opportunity to work in a mission-driven, creative, collaborative, global team.
HOW TO APPLY
Please fill out this APPLICATION FORM , following the instructions outlined.
In this application, you’ll do the following:
Fill out basic information.
Upload your resume/CV.
Submit a cover video describing why you would like to work with us, and what specifically qualifies you for this position. This video should range between 2-3 minutes.

About the Role
Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity. This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player. This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes.
You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when.
You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you.
What You'll Do
Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership
Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM.
As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model.
Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap.
Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect.
Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement.
Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation.
Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements.
Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped.
Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions..
Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off.
Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business.
Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems.
Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability.
Strategic Orchestration & Influence
Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact.
Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners.
Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies.
Lead a rigorous diligence program to evaluate and optimize system performance, workflows, and adoption metrics to strengthen operational quality.
Team Leadership
Directly manage a team of SaaS product managers, each owning a Finance domain (P2P & R2R, QTC, Payroll & Equity).
Set clear direction and priorities for each domain, and create space for deep, high-quality product work.
Develop your team's craft through roadmap review, stakeholder coaching, and regular 1:1s focused on growth.
Serve as an escalation point and thought partner when your PMs hit ambiguity, contention over priorities, or cross-functional friction.
Build the bench: define the team's coverage model, identify gaps, and grow the function as Finance scales.
Hands-On Product Ownership:
Maintain direct ownership over a specific set of applications, leading their product roadmaps and managing key stakeholder relationships.
This isn't a purely managerial role: you'll run intake, prioritize enhancements, manage releases, and partner directly with Finance and the Eng team to deliver in your own portfolio.
Stay close enough to the work to credibly coach your team and make sharp product tradeoffs.
Vendor and Demand Management
Own Finance SaaS vendor relationships at the portfolio level: renewals, SLAs, roadmap influence, escalations, and spend rationalization.
Bring a demand-management mindset to intake; help Finance stakeholders articulate needs, size effort, and sequence work effectively rather than absorbing every request.
Partner with Procurement and Finance leadership on tooling spend, contract timing, and consolidation opportunities.
Maintain a clear view of total cost of ownership and license utilization across the stack.
Stakeholder Partnership
Act as the primary product liaison for Finance leadership, translating business requirements into roadmap decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly.
Partner with FP&A, Technical Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, Payroll, and Finance Operations to understand pain points and proactively surface system improvements.
Work hand-in-glove with the Enterprise Architect and Engineering team to land integrations, data quality, and technical delivery against the product roadmap.
Support M&A activity (e.g., systems due diligence, gap analysis, integration sequencing, and adoption planning for acquired entities).
What We're Looking For
8+ years in product management, business/finance systems, or finance transformation, including 2+ years directly managing people.
Demonstrated ownership of Finance SaaS platforms across multiple domains (ERP, EPM/CPM, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, treasury, or payroll).
Track record of building and running a product/intake operating model: roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, release and change management.
Strong vendor management chops: selection, renewals, SLAs, and influencing vendor roadmaps
Prior people management experience, with a track record of developing PM or systems-analyst talent.
Strong ability to operate across abstraction levels: comfortable in an executive roadmap discussion and in the configuration details of a specific platform.
Excellent communication skills: you can frame a portfolio strategy for a CFO and a sprint priority for an engineer in the same afternoon.
Strong knowledge of financial controls, audit readiness, SOX requirements, data quality, and compliance impacts.
Experience defining close transformation roadmaps, reconciliation strategies, reporting readiness plans, and UAT strategies.
Proven success scaling products and owning business outcomes in high-growth, complex environments.
Bonus Points
Experience at a high-growth public technology company
Familiarity with Reddit's existing Finance tech stack (NetSuite, Workato, Adaptive, Zip, Coupa, Ramp, Workday, Salesforce or comparable) or similar environments
Familiarity with advertising platforms and transformation initiatives spanning quote-to-cash or procure-to-pay workflows
Experience supporting M&A workstreams (diligence, integration, cutover)

Background partnering with Corporate Engineering or shared-services models
Why This Role, Why Reddit
Reddit's Finance organization is scaling rapidly through organic growth, internal investments, and increasing public-company rigor. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Finance technology evolves at a consequential moment: owning the product direction for a portfolio that touches every corner of the company, leading a team, and keeping your own hands on the work.

title: Samsara: Staff Software Engineer
text:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://www.samsara.com/
About the role:
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.
We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.
We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.
This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.
You should apply if:
You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.
You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.
You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.
You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.
You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.
In this role, you will:
Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.
Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.
Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.
Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.
Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.
Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
Minimum requirements for the role:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.
Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.
Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).
Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.
Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.
An ideal candidate also has:
Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.
Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.
Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.
A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.
Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

title: Salesloft: Commercial Account Manager
text:

Job Title: Commercial Account Manager
Location: United States - Remote
This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.
THE OPPORTUNITY:
At Salesloft, our Commercial Account Managers are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing sales team and will be our boots-on-the-ground solution to building personal relationships and making our customers successful. We believe that the most successful sellers have a passionate and supportive team behind them.
On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:
Full-Cycle Account Ownership: Serving as the primary point of contact and ultimate owner of the account relationship, managing all commercial transactions including upsells, cross-sells, and the end-to-end renewal process.
Driving Net-New Revenue: Actively prospecting within your assigned territory to identify, qualify, and close new ACV opportunities within your install base to expand your total book of business. Actively hunt for opportunities to introduce additional products or seat expansions to existing customers, maximizing the lifetime value (LTV) of your portfolio.
Account Planning: Developing and executing success plans for high-value accounts to ensure long-term alignment between their business goals and our solutions.
Proactive Retention Management: Monitoring account health and usage patterns to identify potential churn risks early, implementing "save" strategies to protect existing recurring revenue.
Executive Relationship Building: Cultivating ties with VPs, C-suite executives and key stakeholders to move beyond a vendor relationship and become a trusted business advisor.
Forecasting & Pipeline Accuracy: Provide leadership with accurate monthly, and quarterly revenue forecasts for both net new bookings and churn.
Market & Competitive Intelligence: Staying up to date of industry trends and competitor movements to effectively position our value proposition against market alternatives.
Collaborative Problem Solving: Partnering with Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to resolve complex client issues and ensure seamless post-sale transitions.
Segmented Renewal Strategy: Partnering with Renewal Account Managers to streamline the execution of long-tail, lower-spend accounts, while simultaneously identifying and "cherry-picking" growth potential within that book to migrate into higher-value tiers.
In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to sell an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:
We are seeking a results-oriented, motivated, and strategic Commercial Account Manager. You are a growth-minded advocate who is laser-focused on deepening and expanding relationships within our existing customer base. You don't just manage accounts; you hunt for untapped potential, identifying new use cases and scaling our footprint across organizations.
Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us become an anchor technology company by securing high-value renewals and winning expansion deals that propel you past your quota.
If you're passionate about sales technology, obsessed with delivering a world-class customer experience, and thrive in a fast-paced, hyper-growth startup environment, then this is the career path for you!
THE TEAM:
Our Salesloft Commercial Sales team is comprised of motivated sales professionals with a strong desire to win.
Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.
The Commercial Account Management team consists of results-oriented SaaS sales professionals with a strong desire to win. The Account Managers on our team share a few common traits: they are self-motivated, ambitious, and passionate about evangelizing the future of sales innovation.
THE SKILL SET:
2-3 years of proven relationship building & closing experience in a SaaS environment
Experience establishing strategic C-level relationships
Ability to run a full sales lifecycle, start to finish, within the SMB segment
Experience executing detailed product presentations and web demonstrations of our software capabilities to C-level executives, directors, and sales managers
Adept at identifying and utilizing internal resources (Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Support etc.) to build Salesloft brand awareness, assist in sales cycles, and close deals.
Collaborative mentality by prioritizing 'we' and not focusing on 'me.'
Superb listening skills; you must understand objections and defeat them by turning skeptics into ecstatic new customers
High level of empathy - it's important for our AM's to be a good person to peers and prospects.
Experience managing, expanding, and renewing customer relationships.
Consistent overachievement of quota and revenue goals.
Proven ability to make strong connections and overcome rejection to achieve results.
Demonstrated ability to conduct compelling on-site and virtual presentations to C-Level executives.

title: Legion: Chief Architect
text:
Headquarters: Remote, United States
Chief Architect
Remote - US
Legion Technologies is building the AI-powered operating system for the hourly workforce. We are hiring a Chief Architect to serve as Legion’s most senior hands-on technical leader and to shape the technical foundation that will power the next decade of product innovation.
This is not a strategy-only or advisory role. The Chief Architect must live close to the code, go deep with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, write and review technical designs, make high-consequence architecture decisions, and help turn bold product ambitions into scalable, reliable production systems.
This person will own architecture and technical decision-making for the most complex parts of Legion’s Workforce Management platform, including AI, optimization, forecasting, scheduling, distributed systems, data platforms, real-time decisioning, enterprise scalability, security, compliance, and developer productivity.
The ideal candidate has built and scaled mission-critical software used by large enterprise customers, has deep technical credibility with senior engineers, and can operate fluidly between code-level decisions and long-term platform strategy. They are pragmatic, decisive, opinionated, and comfortable making hard tradeoffs when simplicity, scalability, reliability, or customer trust require it.
This role reports to the Head of Product, Engineering, and Support. This is an open role currently being filled on an interim basis by the CEO.
Responsibilities and Duties
Hands-On Architecture and Technical Decision-Making
Serve as Legion’s senior-most hands-on technical authority for complex architecture, system design, and platform evolution.
Personally dive into code, design documents, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and implementation tradeoffs to diagnose root causes and guide technical direction.
Lead the hardest technical decisions across AI systems, optimization engines, distributed systems, data architecture, reliability, scalability, security, and platform modernization.
Write prototypes, reference implementations, architecture decision records, technical specifications, and design patterns where needed to unblock teams and establish clear direction.
Make high-consequence technical decisions with incomplete information, balancing correctness, simplicity, speed, scalability, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability.
Challenge architectural drift, unnecessary complexity, weak abstractions, and short-term decisions that create long-term platform risk.
Partner directly with Staff, Principal, and senior engineering leaders in design reviews, code-level discussions, and implementation planning.
Platform Architecture and Technical Vision
Define and own the long-term architecture for Legion’s AI-driven Workforce Management platform across application services, data infrastructure, ML systems, optimization engines, APIs, integration architecture, developer platforms, and enterprise-scale operations.
Establish engineering-wide standards for system design, scalability, performance, reliability, extensibility, observability, security, and maintainability.
Serve as the final architectural authority for major platform initiatives and technical decisions with long-term consequences.
Identify opportunities to reduce complexity, improve system efficiency, accelerate engineering velocity, and unlock new product capabilities.
Proactively surface technical debt, architectural risk, and platform constraints before they compound into customer, product, or engineering velocity issues.
Create pragmatic migration paths from current-state architecture to target-state architecture while maintaining uptime, customer trust, backward compatibility, and delivery speed.
Ensure Legion’s architecture supports enterprise configurability and extensibility without allowing uncontrolled customization or product fragmentation.
AI, Optimization, and Decision Systems
Architect AI-native product capabilities across forecasting, scheduling, labor optimization, recommendations, copilots or agents, anomaly detection, decision automation, and other intelligent workforce management use cases.
Define the architecture for production AI systems, including data pipelines, feature platforms, model training, model serving, retrieval, evaluation, monitoring, feedback loops, and continuous improvement.
Make clear build-versus-buy decisions across LLMs, classical ML, optimization solvers, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and internal AI platforms.
Partner closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to turn mathematically complex labor optimization problems into reliable, scalable, explainable production systems.
Establish standards for AI system quality, including accuracy, latency, cost, explainability, drift detection, reliability, customer-specific behavior, and production observability.
Ensure Legion’s AI capabilities remain differentiated, defensible, enterprise-ready, and deeply integrated into operational workflows rather than bolted on as superficial features.
Distributed Systems, Data, and Enterprise Scale
Drive architecture for large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS systems serving complex enterprise customers with high availability, performance, security, and compliance expectations.
Lead technical decisions involving microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed data processing, real-time systems, data governance, and large-scale analytics.
Improve the architecture for observability, incident analysis, performance engineering, capacity planning, reliability, and operational excellence.
Use production data, incidents, escalations, and customer operational patterns as inputs into architecture and platform improvement.
Ensure architectural decisions support global scale, data residency, enterprise integrations, configurability, extensibility, and long-term platform leverage.
Product, Business, and Customer Impact
Connect technical decisions directly to customer value, product velocity, implementation speed, scalability, reliability, and long-term platform advantage.
Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate ambitious product goals into executable architecture and technical roadmaps.
Understand enterprise customer complexity and design systems that support real-world operational variability without creating unsustainable technical debt.
Support strategic customer, partner, and vendor architecture discussions where deep technical credibility is required.
Help evaluate technical implications of major product, partner, platform, and commercial decisions.
Engineering Culture and Technical Talent
Mentor and elevate Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, architects, and senior engineering leaders across the organization.
Raise the bar for technical judgment, system design, architecture reviews, documentation, code quality, operational discipline, and engineering craftsmanship.
Help assess, attract, and develop senior technical talent, including Staff, Principal, and architect-level engineers.
Build a culture of disciplined technical thinking, direct debate, clear decision-making, and pragmatic execution.
Ensure architectural decisions are documented clearly, understood broadly, and translated into executable engineering plans.
Security, Compliance, and Enterprise Readiness
Own the architectural approach to enterprise security, data governance, privacy, compliance, auditability, and resilience.
Ensure architecture supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, data residency, access control, tenant isolation, regulatory requirements, and other needs of large global enterprise customers.
Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Product, and Engineering teams to make security and compliance foundational architectural properties rather than after-the-fact controls.
Travel Requirements
Up to 15% travel for leadership collaboration, engineering offsites, strategic customer engagements, and other business-critical meetings.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Experience Level
15+ years of experience building and scaling large-scale software systems. Prior experience as a Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Principal Architect, very senior Principal Engineer, or equivalent senior technical leadership role.
Demonstrated success designing and scaling mission-critical, multi-tenant SaaS platforms for enterprise customers.
Deep hands-on experience with large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, data platforms, APIs, event-driven systems, platform engineering, and high-availability production environments.
Proven ability to operate as a hands-on technical leader who can credibly engage in code-level and design-level discussions with senior engineers.
Experience making major architecture decisions for systems with high scale, high reliability requirements, complex domain logic, and long product lifecycles.
Experience modernizing large production systems incrementally while maintaining uptime, backward compatibility, customer trust, and engineering velocity.
Experience building or supporting AI, ML, optimization, decisioning, forecasting, or data-intensive products in production.
Strong understanding of observability, incident response, performance engineering, reliability architecture, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering teams, executives, customers, and cross-functional partners.
Technical Depth
Deep expertise in distributed systems, system design, cloud architecture, service-oriented or microservices architectures, APIs, event-driven systems, and large-scale data processing.
Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Strong experience with modern engineering practices, including architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, testing strategy, deployment architecture, observability, and production operations.
Experience with languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, Scala, or similar modern backend languages.
Ability to reason deeply about tradeoffs involving performance, latency, throughput, cost, reliability, developer productivity, extensibility, and maintainability.
Leadership and Judgment
Strong architectural judgment: knows when to simplify, when to re-platform, when to tolerate debt, and when to force a hard technical reset.
Demonstrated ability to make bold technical decisions with incomplete information and drive alignment across senior technical and executive stakeholders.
Ability to influence without relying on hierarchy, while still being willing to make clear decisions when consensus is insufficient.
Strong product and business judgment; able to connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes, implementation speed, product differentiation, and company strategy.
Pragmatic builder mindset: balances long-term architecture with startup speed, customer urgency, and execution realities.
Preferred Qualifications and Attributes
Experience building platforms used by millions of users or supporting very large-scale enterprise operations.
Experience at companies known for large-scale distributed systems, AI, cloud infrastructure, enterprise SaaS, workforce management, supply chain, fintech, commerce, logistics, or other complex operational domains.
Familiarity with optimization engines, scheduling algorithms, forecasting systems, constraint solvers, real-time decision systems, or mathematically complex production systems.
Experience architecting AI-native product capabilities, including LLM-enabled workflows, AI agents or copilots, model evaluation, retrieval systems, feedback loops, and production monitoring.
Experience building internal developer platforms, platform infrastructure, data platforms, ML pipelines, or large-scale analytics systems.
Experience designing highly configurable enterprise platforms without creating unbounded customization or implementation complexity.
Experience participating in strategic customer architecture reviews or technical due diligence with large enterprise customers.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; PhD a plus but not required.
Candidate Profile
The strongest candidate will be a deeply technical, hands-on architect who still has the range to shape company-level technical direction. They are not a generic enterprise architect, process owner, or strategy-only leader. They are a builder and technical decision-maker who can personally engage with Legion’s hardest problems and earn the respect of the strongest engineers in the company.
They should be comfortable moving between:
Code and architecture.
Product ambition and technical feasibility.
AI innovation and production reliability.
Startup speed and enterprise-grade rigor.
Long-term platform strategy and immediate technical execution.
They should be opinionated but not dogmatic, decisive but not reckless, and pragmatic without accepting mediocrity. They should be able to simplify complex systems, identify the real technical risks, and force clarity where teams are stuck in ambiguity.
Compensation and Benefits

title: Track it Forward: Lead Developer — Rebuild, Modernize, & Scale (Social Good SaaS, Remote)
text:
Headquarters: Oakland, CA
URL: https://www.trackitforward.com
We are looking for a lead developer to do a greenfield rebuild of our legacy SaaS app, modernize our mobile apps, and lead the tech effort to scale our app. You will help choose the language, build the technical foundation, work with our product manager to rebuild the app, and migrate all customers over.
About Track it Forward Track it Forward is the leading volunteer time-tracking application for nonprofits and schools. For 15 years, we’ve helped thousands of organizations mobilize volunteers and track over 30 million hours. We are a profitable, bootstrapped team of 4 focused on great work-life balance, high-impact work, and a fun, puzzle-loving culture (daily crosswords, monthly virtual escape rooms, and annual retreats). We are not a VC-funded startup. We grew organically, stayed profitable, and prioritize high-quality work and personal fulfillment without growth-at-all-costs pressure. The team is led by the original founder and developer.
The Modernization Strategy This is a structured, phased "small bang" migration—not a high-risk cutover or a strangler-fig migration. You will build a parallel greenfield system, extract legacy components step-by-step, and migrate customers over incrementally tenant-by-tenant while keeping operations running smoothly.
Current Tech : Drupal 6 architecture hosted on Pantheon, paired with two Ionic/Capacitor mobile apps.
Your Scope: Complete ownership of the technical architecture. You will partner with our product manager, establish engineering processes, and lead the rebuild from scratch.
Modern AI practices : We want you to be on the cusp of AI workflows while also balancing human guardrails to produce quality code.
Team Structure: You will be our sole developer in the short term, taking full technical helm as we scale.
Target Stack & Responsibilities
Core Tech Stack: Core backend/frontend rebuild focused on Python/Django, Laravel, or React. You will make the final architectural call with input from the CEO/founder.
Database & Storage Extraction: Deconstruct our legacy Drupal 6 / MySQL schema into a clean, domain-driven PostgreSQL database, and offload 100GB+ of media files to AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2.
Security & Isolation : Implement application-layer field-level encryption (AES-256 for PII, Bcrypt/Argon2id for passwords) and build zero-trust dev environments so contractors never handle production user data.
CI/CD & Documentation: Establish automated testing pipelines, clean API contracts, and clear runbooks so the codebase remains maintainable long-term.
Mobile App Maintenance: Maintain and update our two Ionic/Capacitor mobile apps using AI coding tools. Mobile is a small fraction of the overall role—you just need to leverage AI to keep them functional without being a native mobile expert.
Candidate Qualifications
Pre-AI Engineering Foundation: 5+ years of core software engineering and architectural experience established before generative AI existed. You hold strong first-principles opinions on database normalization and system patterns.
Proven Migration Experience: You have successfully architected and led at least one legacy monolith migration. You know what inputs and scope decisions keep momentum going.
Modernized AI Velocity: You actively use AI tools to multiply output, but retain strict architectural control, unit testing discipline, and manual code review standards.
Location & Remote Flexibility
US W-2 Tax Residency Required: You must be legally authorized to work in the US and maintain primary US tax residency (for payroll, contracts, and legal/tax compliance).
Travel-Friendly: We are 100% remote. As long as your primary legal/tax home remains in the US, you are welcome to travel or digital nomad—provided you can consistently hit our core sync hours.
Core Sync Hours: Mandatory availability from 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM PST for daily team syncs and real-time collaboration. Flexible hours outside this window.
Compensation & Benefits
Base Salary: $150,000 – $200,000 / year (commensurate with experience)
Benefits: 401(k) w/ company match, Health Insurance, vacation, PTO, and holdiays
Culture: High autonomy, direct project ownership, and zero venture-capital growth pressure
How to Apply To filter out automated spam: include the most authentically human, non-AI reason why this specific role resonates with you. Specifically include a short Loom video of you in the “Why should we choose you over any one else?” question. This isn’t required but will sure stand out. Be authentic, no need to do crazy rehearsals, just be you.
